steps.content:
Based on the two links you sent, both sellers are offering the **exact same product** on essentially identical terms:

**Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Customer rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Stock / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs** | over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency, up to 40h battery with ANC on, USB-C (10min = 5h), Bluetooth 5.3 two-device pairing, 254g | Same |
| **In the box** | headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable | headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable |

There is no difference in price, shipping speed/cost, return policy, or ratings shown on the listings.

**The only meaningful difference listed is:**

**B - Ottervale Audio states: "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**

A - Brackmoor Sound just says "Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound" with no mention of authorized dealer status.

**Recommendation: If you have to choose one, choose B - Ottervale Audio**

Why: At the same price and terms, the explicit "Authorized dealer + Full manufacturer warranty" gives you extra assurance that:
1. The unit is genuine / sourced directly from Quellwyn
2. Any warranty claim in the next year will be handled as a full manufacturer warranty, not just a seller warranty

It doesn't mean A is not genuine or won't honor the warranty - both list a 1-year limited warranty - but B makes that guarantee explicit on the listing.

If authorized status doesn't matter to you, there is no other difference between the two and either would be a comparable purchase. You should still verify the seller's current return/warranty details at checkout before buying, as those can change.
